# Lunajson 1.2.3

Unmodified JSON decoder and encoder from [grafi-tt/lunajson](https://github.com/grafi-tt/lunajson/tree/250afac121df831f449d6370ddf406673f6f9c2b), commit `250afac121df831f449d6370ddf406673f6f9c2b`. The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

The launcher uses these pure-Lua files directly. No LuaRocks installation or native JSON module is required. `../../runtime.lua` preserves explicit JSON object, array and null types and validates UTF-8 and finite numbers.
